name: Whisperio – AI Dictation
subtitle: Voice Typing, Your Own API Key
promotionalText: Dictation for your Mac: press a global hotkey, speak, and the text lands where you type. On-device by default, or bring your own AI key. No account, no server.
description:
Whisperio turns your voice into text in any Mac app: press a global hotkey, speak, and the transcript is pasted where you're typing.

DICTATE ANYWHERE ON YOUR MAC
Global hotkeys start and stop dictation in any app. "Dictate & Send" submits the text right away; Command Mode runs a saved instruction on what you said.

TRANSCRIBE WHAT'S PLAYING
Capture what your Mac is playing (meetings, calls, videos) and turn it into text. macOS requires the Screen Recording permission for audio capture; Whisperio never reads your screen.

YOUR PROVIDERS, YOUR KEYS
Apple on-device speech recognition by default. Add your own API key for OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Groq, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Mistral or Replicate, point Whisperio at a self-hosted server, or download a local Whisper model. No Whisperio account, no subscription, no markup on API usage.

AI CLEANUP, ON YOUR TERMS
Raw dictation pastes instantly. When you want polished text, run on-demand AI cleanup or a saved rewrite template. AI-generated text is marked as such.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No Whisperio server. Audio goes directly from your Mac to the engine you chose, or stays on the Mac with on-device engines. API keys live in the macOS Keychain.

STAYS IN SYNC
Optional iCloud sync keeps your dictation history in step with Whisperio on iPhone and iPad, in your private iCloud database. Audio stays on the device that recorded it.
